flow.buoyancy_model: nonlinear ideal-gas density correction with fixed-reference-density incompressible equations
flow.label: 兩門全開
flow.pressure_reference: Natural traction at modeled room-side makeup boundary; leakage network pressure drop reported separately.

velocity_transport.method: RT0 H(div) least-energy normal-flux reconstruction from P1 FEM velocities
velocity_transport.boundary_fixed: hood normal flux fixed to FEM value, wall flux zero; door and interior fluxes projected

tracer.label: 兩門全開
tracer.concentration_unit: s/m³ per unit total emission rate; multiply by actual emission units/s for actual units/m³
tracer.inventory_unit: equivalent source-seconds; divide by release_duration_s for retained fraction
tracer.clearance_heat_condition: Hold steady 4000W heat and fan; stop only tracer release
tracer.note: Steady total hood fraction may be forced to unity if it is the only tracer outflow; use finite-time retention, occupied-zone concentration and decay instead of calling this real capture efficiency.
